requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, source CRS WKID 102100/3857, extent, APN/APN_CHR/POLY_CODE fields, GeoJSON support and County/City attribution.

Anonymous point-intersection query at the exact WUP coordinate returned one full polygon with APN_CHR 11512305. Requested only safe parcel identity/classification fields and geometry; no owner, address, tax, titleholder or contact fields were requested.
Official Community Development page identifies GIS Mapping and a public GIS District Viewer/property-information entry point.
Official Surveyor page documents public parcel-map and survey-record retrieval; no private session or login used.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: native APN_CHR is present and stable in the source schema; runtime admission remains held pending independent serial review
